column1: # THE WITNESS AND THE RESTORATION FOR SITE-A64-CC-INV.
WITNESS_COMPILER_BUILD_RC=0 (the witness program compiled with the mutated production compiler)
WITNESS_RESTORED_SEMANTIC_OBSERVATION=emitted: b.ge ; program output: LT_OK ; exit 0 (the source was restored byte-identically and the compiler rebuilt)
DISCRIMINATING=YES (the mutated observation differs from the pristine observation in BOTH the emitted assembly and the compiled program's output)
RESTORATION_SOURCE_PROOF=git checkout -- src/aarch64.c in the disposable worktree; the source SHA-256 is bit-identical to the pristine

RESTORATION_OBJECT_PROOF=the whole production compiler was rebuilt from the restored source and every witness returned to its pristine observation (see the per-site witness-and-restoration.tsv of each of the three sites)

DETERMINISTIC_LIMITATION=the linked executable's SHA-256 is NOT byte-reproducible across worktrees, because the compiler embeds its own build path and a build identity string. The SOURCE restoration is byte-identical, and the OBSERVED SEMANTICS of every witness are restored exactly. The executable digest difference is therefore an explained, embedded-provenance difference and NOT a semantic difference.
